items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: I know it. And I had no idea who it was because Jones-Smith, that doesn’t tell you anything. But I found out.

ctx.x: That’s really interesting too that you happened to hit upon that first recording.
I know it. And I had no idea who it was because Jones-Smith, that doesn’t tell you anything. But I found out. © Fillius Jazz Archive -26-
Wow. Well I’m glad you played the trombone instead of the tenor sax, because you’ve played with so many great people. Best of luck and keep doing it.
